conclusion: A source-locked ELF/MsgPack parse is provenance and launch-metadata evidence, not proof that gem5 can execute the ISA.
decision: Keep code-object validation and gfx950 execution acceptance as separate gates.
invalidated_assumptions: Matching ELF headers and metadata automatically proves decoder compatibility.
observation: Both locked fixtures validate as ELF V6/gfx950, while the authority records missing gfx950 decoder proof and an unsupported binary-search opcode.
question_or_symptom: A parser test passed even though the current gem5 decoder cannot establish gfx950 feature equivalence.
